snippet.title: Trailer Amusement Factory game
snippet.description:
Become the next theme park tycoon or roller coaster rockstar in this game for Windows/MacOS/iPad.

Build the theme park of your dreams. Lay out the paths, place the rides, open the shops, and ensure that every visitor—from the moment they enter until they catch the last bus home—has a smile on their face. A cheerful, charming park simulator offering endless fun.

Go to https://www.amusementfactory.app to wishlist the game! Release november 10, 2026
